title: [Bug] Helper app lookup uses hardcoded "Electron Helper" name — fatal crash when app is renamed by packager (macOS 26, arm64)
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

42.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS Tahoe 26.5 (Darwin 25.5.0)

### What arch are you using?

arm64 (including Apple Silicon)

### Last Known Working Electron version

Unknown — not yet tested on macOS 15 or earlier. The issue may be specific to macOS 26.

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

No

### Expected Behavior

A packaged Electron app whose product name differs from "Electron" (i.e. every real-world app) should launch correctly on macOS 26 arm64.

The helper app path should be resolved at runtime using the main bundle's name — for example, by reading `CFBundleName` from `Info.plist` — so that standard packager behavior (renaming `Electron Helper.app` to `MyApp Helper.app`) works without requiring binary patching.


### Actual Behavior


The app crashes immediately on launch with exit code **133 (SIGTRAP)** and no output.

Running the binary directly from the terminal reveals the fatal error:

```
[FATAL:electron/shell/app/electron_main_delegate_mac.mm:66] Unable to find helper app
```

The Electron binary appears to resolve its helper processes using a name fixed at compile time (`Electron Helper`) rather than derived at runtime from the app bundle's `CFBundleName`. When a packager renames the helper bundles to match the product name (standard practice), the binary can no longer find them.

This was confirmed by the following test:

```bash
# Start from the unmodified node_modules Electron.app
cp -R node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app /tmp/TestApp.app

# Simulate what electron-builder does: rename helpers
mv "/tmp/TestApp.app/Contents/Frameworks/Electron Helper.app" \
   "/tmp/TestApp.app/Contents/Frameworks/TestApp Helper.app"
mv "/tmp/TestApp.app/Contents/Frameworks/Electron Helper (GPU).app" \
   "/tmp/TestApp.app/Contents/Frameworks/TestApp Helper (GPU).app"
mv "/tmp/TestApp.app/Contents/Frameworks/Electron Helper (Plugin).app" \
   "/tmp/TestApp.app/Contents/Frameworks/TestApp Helper (Plugin).app"
mv "/tmp/TestApp.app/Contents/Frameworks/Electron Helper (Renderer).app" \
   "/tmp/TestApp.app/Contents/Frameworks/TestApp Helper (Renderer).app"

xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /tmp/TestApp.app

/tmp/TestApp.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron
# → [FATAL] Unable to find helper app  (exit 133)
```

Restoring helpers to their original `Electron Helper*.app` names makes the app launch correctly.

Additionally, the packaged binary is **byte-for-byte identical** to the original from the npm package (same SHA-256 hash), confirming it was never patched:

```bash
shasum -a 256 "dist/mac-arm64/MyApp.app/Contents/MacOS/MyApp"
# c86c2701f15ca66ba460f4cdcd7ebcab0b5133a4cc299295f02108b3754e9eed

shasum -a 256 "node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron"
# c86c2701f15ca66ba460f4cdcd7ebcab0b5133a4cc299295f02108b3754e9eed
```


### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/ElRochito/f251a4231213679f31a6c97d5b8ab625

### Additional Information


**Workaround** (in electron-builder): add an `afterPack` hook that renames the helpers back to their original `Electron Helper*.app` names after packaging. See companion issue filed against [electron-builder](https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder).

**What did NOT help:**
- Setting `hardenedRuntime: false` in electron-builder config
- Setting `identity: null` to skip code signing
- Removing the quarantine attribute (`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine`)
- Re-signing the bundle with `codesign --force --deep -s -`
- All FUSE flags are identical between working and failing binaries (`EnableEmbeddedAsarIntegrityValidation` is disabled in both)

**Suggested fix:** In `electron/shell/app/electron_main_delegate_mac.mm` around line 66, derive the helper name from `[NSBundle.mainBundle objectForInfoDictionaryKey:@"CFBundleName"]` at runtime rather than using a compile-time constant, e.g.:

```objc
NSString *bundleName = [NSBundle.mainBundle objectForInfoDictionaryKey:@"CFBundleName"];
NSString *helperName = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@ Helper", bundleName];
```

This would make the helper resolution robust to any product name without requiring binary patching.
